name: 25 oz. TITAN Tritan Plastic Water Bottles
description: Make the most of your workout with this super-sized sport-style water bottle. This 9.65" x 2.75" bottle is made of tough Tritan material with flip-top spillproof lid, carrying handle and reusable straw. The construction is BPA free for those that like to think green, and holds a big 25 ounces of your favorite beverage. Select from seven cool colors, and add your school, sports team, organizational or company logo, emblem or message to create a refreshing branded promotion. Makes a great gift or giveaway at grand openings, seminars, trade show or convention tables.
